tasks.label: Rerun Prisma build and Docker validation
args: npx prisma generate && npm run build && docker compose config

tasks.label: Start Docker and seed demo tests
args: docker compose up --build -d && docker compose logs --no-color db-seed && docker compose ps -a

tasks.label: Check Docker seeder result
args: docker compose ps -a && docker compose logs --tail=80 --no-color db-seed

tasks.label: Inspect MySQL timestamp column types
args: docker compose exec -T mysql mysql -uroot -pdev1012 IELTS_Pratice -e "SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'createdAt'; SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'updatedAt';"

tasks.label: Check MySQL user timestamp types
args: docker compose exec -T mysql mysql -N -B -uroot -pdev1012 IELTS_Pratice -e "SELECT COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE FROM information_schema.columns WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME=0x7573657273 AND COLUMN_NAME IN (0x637265617465644174,0x757064617465644174)"

tasks.label: Rebuild Docker seeder with matching schema
args: docker compose up --build -d && docker compose logs --no-color db-seed

tasks.label: Verify Docker seeding completed
args: docker compose ps -a && docker compose logs --tail=80 --no-color db-seed
